name: Evolve a Cell
desc:
🦠 You're a tiny cell in a pond full of hungry things
🍃 Eat plants or hunt other cells... including players
🧬 Evolve! Add jaws, spikes, eyes, tails and more
🎨 Shape and paint your own creature
🐋 Grow huge and take down giant bosses

Evolve or get eaten 😈

(inspired by spore ! )
